candidates.violated_requirement: Gray-to-binary conversion should use XOR operations between adjacent bits. Using OR instead of XOR for the second bit conversion will produce incorrect binary values, leading to wrong Gray code output.
candidates.spec_basis: The implementation should follow this process: 1. Input a Gray code value (use an internal wire variable initialized to 0) 2. Convert the Gray code to binary representation

candidates.violated_requirement: The binary value should increment by 1 every two clock cycles. Not incrementing will cause the counter to stay at the same value, breaking the Gray code sequence.
Binary-to-Gray conversion requires XOR operation between the binary value and its right-shifted version. Using AND instead will produce incorrect Gray code values.
candidates.spec_basis: 4. Convert the incremented binary back to Gray code
